name: jev-flowmap
description: Read a codebase before you change it: map its user flows, and audit what its model calls cost.

plugins.name: jev-flowmap
plugins.description: Two ways to read a codebase before you change it. Map every user flow with per-step evidence and dead-end detection, and audit every operation into code, LLM or classifier columns ranked by share of the bill. Static only: it never runs, builds or opens the project.
